notes: Day 25 (Abba Bula "Abib") continues and ends; a new commemoration (Abba Eblo'i of Akmim, "ወበዛቲ ዕለት" / "በዚችም ቀን") starts at the bottom and is the same Day 25 (no day opener). First lines continue p99 ¶፲፬ (Ge'ez joined with a space after ወትቤሎ፡ሰላም፡ ; Amharic after ከአእላፍ፡መላእክት፡ጋር፡).
